name: Grillo Sinfonico
description_en: A friendly conductor cricket in Pixar style, bright green glossy body, large round eyes with kind expression, wearing a tiny black bowtie and holding a small leaf-shaped conductor baton, long antennae curved like musical notes, small translucent wings folded on back, slender legs. Musical maestro of the forest.
description_es: Un grillo director amigable estilo Pixar, cuerpo verde brillante, ojos grandes redondos con expresión amable, lleva una pajarita negra diminuta y sostiene una batuta pequeña en forma de hoja, antenas largas curvadas como notas musicales, alas pequeñas translúcidas plegadas en la espalda, patas delgadas. Maestro musical del bosque.
style_prompt: 3D rendered, Pixar-style, soft lighting, warm pastel colors, children's storybook illustration, magical atmosphere
